∀ {n : ℕ} (R : ℕ),
  1 ≤ R →
    ∀ (event : ℕ → (Fin n → ℝ) → Option (Fin n × ℝ)) (K : ℕ),
      (∀ k < K, event k (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.timing R event k).starts ≠ none) →
        ∀ (k : ℕ),
          (fun m => if m < K then OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delays R event m else m) k ≤ k ∧
            k < (fun m => if m < K then OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delays R event m else m) k + R
